payload.instance: uuid — the battlemap instance whose open combat is reordered, when the command names no target; never written
payload.order: array of uuid — every participant of the open combat once, first rank first, each named by its token or by its initiative entry; one omitted, repeated or not in the combat is refused. Each entry's rank becomes its place in the order, 1 to n without gap or duplicate, a hidden participant like any other (hidden-keeps-rank); no participant is added or removed, the turn and the round stay
payload.entry: uuid — never sent by the DM: the command's own follow-ups, one per participant after the first, each writing the rank of that entry in the order it carries, judged again against the combat, and refused unless every entry ahead of it in that order holds its new rank in the queue
